verdict.rationale: Splitting a single sale across multiple payment methods or payers is a fair question for an in-person payments product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers payment methods, tipping, refunds, offline payments and Tap to Pay, but nothing documents split-tender, partial payments, or splitting one sale between payers. Broad claims about accepting global and local payment methods do not show that one sale can be split.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can split a single sale across multiple payment methods or payers
